body: Read-only orchestration finding, no takeover or implementation: at main bf65220959c7601427247286abc7eb16278af5a5, aida-cli-lib/src/lib.rs collect_open_prs_uncached (81097) does not request isDraft in its gh pr list JSON fields; parse_open_pr_snapshot (81657) constructs OpenPrItem with is_draft:false constant, even when JSON contains true. New awaiting/reviews draft consumers therefore cannot see actual draft status through this producer. BUG-1812 acceptance specifically requires the actual draft-held checkpoint shape not to recommend merge/clear. Root read full canonical BUG-1812 acceptance and actual collector/parser, requested independent verification; no runtime claim yet. Please have the already reserved BUG-1812 owner assess and correct under its own review workflow, including producer-to-consumer regression. Root will not edit/reopen/dispatch that reserved spec.
